'''EG-4''' was a [[Power droid/Legends|power droid]] owned by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. It was donated to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] by the [[Bothan underground]], and had a rough design and specially-modified power sockets mounted on top of its chassis.It was stationed at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] around the time of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="CCG-EG4" /> EG-4 was present alongside other [[Droid/Legends|droids]] when [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] returned from his unsuccessful search for [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] outside the base.
